You own the numbers behind that work: the SQL, calculators, and AI prompts that pull values out of claims and medical records and test them against clinical criteria, with a focus on DRG and outpatient review. Nurses, physicians, and engineers bring the clinical judgment; you turn it into working logic. Partner with clinical subject matter experts, physician reviewers, data engineers, and a program manager to turn requirements into working logic. Document your logic so teammates can pick it up. Job Description OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE We are seeking a strong Senior Analyst to serve as a hands-on contributor across Tableau dashboarding and commercial analytics within Takeda's GCC Commercial Insights & Analytics (I&A) organization in India. This role carries significant individual analytical ownership — building enterprise-grade reporting and dashboards in Tableau while independently delivering mid-to-high complexity commercial analytics workstreams that inform global brand strategy. The Senior Analyst is a critical analytical contributor who drives the quality and depth of insights delivered to global brand teams and begins to shape the analytical direction of assigned workstreams. Own and independently deliver a portfolio of reporting and dashboard products in Tableau, and serve as a go-to resource for visual analytics across assigned brands and indications. Apply strong Tableau capabilities — LOD expressions, parameters and actions, table calculations, and Tableau Server/Cloud publishing — and follow data visualization best practices and design standards (layout, color, accessibility, interactivity, storytelling). Establish and monitor KPIs and metrics — patient shares, new starts, duration of therapy (DoT), adherence, source of business, and campaign effectiveness — across global markets, regions, and channels. Maintain data models, extracts, and refresh pipelines feeding dashboards to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance. Commercial Analytics & Insight Generation Own end-to-end delivery of assigned performance analytics workstreams that track brand KPIs across global, regional, and country levels. Integrate and analyze diverse commercial data sources across markets — real-world data (claims, EMR/EHR, lab data), specialty pharmacy, sales, and channel data — to generate comprehensive patient and HCP insights that support brand strategy and launch readiness. Develop and maintain business rules for processing raw patient-level data, leveraging a strong understanding of data nuances, commercial context, and market knowledge to ensure analytical accuracy and consistency. Conduct advanced, self-directed exploratory data analysis (EDA) and opportunity prospecting — moving beyond basic pulls (counts, topline, segmentation, time trends) to surface non-obvious commercial opportunities and hypotheses. Lead custom reporting and complex ad hoc analysis requests with independent hypothesis formulation, rigorous methodology, and well-documented, insight-rich outputs. Stakeholder Collaboration & Mentorship Partner with GCC Managers and global I&A brand leads to clarify requirements, align on scope, and synthesize findings into decision-oriented visual stories with clear “so what” recommendations. Provide informal mentoring and quality guidance to Analyst colleagues, and contribute to team knowledge management (visualization standards, design patterns, reusable templates and query libraries). KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Education: Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field; Master's degree or MBA strongly preferred. Experience: 4–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial analytics or healthcare analytics, with demonstrated independent ownership of both analytics deliverables and reporting/dashboard development. Strong, hands-on Tableau experience building and maintaining dashboards is required; exposure to Tableau Server/Cloud publishing is preferred and Tableau certification is a plus. Working knowledge of Power BI is a plus. Deep working knowledge of pharma commercial datasets across markets: patient-level claims (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health), specialty pharmacy, EMR, and sales data is required. Hands-on experience with data beyond claims is strongly preferred — lab data, EMR/EHR, medical and regulatory coding systems (e.g., ICD, procedure/reimbursement codes), public datasets, and research literature (Citeline, PubMed). Proficiency in coding techniques such as SQL, SAS, R, or Python for data manipulation and workflow automation; advanced Excel required. Familiarity with API programming and GenAI (e.g., Claude Code) as a coding partner; working knowledge of Databricks or cloud platforms preferred. Experience supporting global or regional brand teams or cross-functional analytics programs is strongly preferred. Skills & Competencies: Tableau Development & Reporting — Strong Tableau design and development following visualization and self-service reporting best practices. Data Visualization & Storytelling — Applies visualization and storytelling principles — layout, color, accessibility, and interactivity — to build intuitive, decision-ready products. Advanced Commercial Data Analysis — Independently designs and executes complex analyses on multi-source, multi-market pharma datasets; advances from basic pulls to self-directed EDA and prospecting. Stakeholder Communication — Communicates analytical findings persuasively to global I&A leads; adapts framing to technical and commercial audiences. Informal Mentorship — Provides practical guidance to junior analysts on analytical techniques, data interpretation, and quality standards. Intangible Skills: Curiosity · Confidence · Reflective · High risk tolerance · Organized · High command of written and spoken English fluency. Collaborate Cross-Functionally — Contribute positively to GCC and global team workflows and cross-functional collaboration. Drive Accountability — Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
